verse_text_english: You have attained a great blessing from your Lord; you are not crazy.
You have attained a recompense that is well deserved.
You are blessed with a great moral character.
You will see, and they will see.
Which of you are condemned.
Your Lord is fully aware of those who strayed off His path, and He is fully aware of those who are guided.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو أعلم بالمهتدين

verse_text_english: Do not obey the rejectors.
They wish that you compromise, so they too can compromise.
Do not obey every lowly swearer.
A slanderer, a backbiter.
Forbidder of charity, a transgressor, a s
Unappreciative, and greedy.
Even though he possessed enough mon
When our revelations are recited to him
verse_text_arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذا تتلى عليه ءايتنا قال أسطير الأولين

verse_text_english: We will mark his face.

verse_text_english: They were so absolutely sure.

verse_text_arabic_clean: فطاف عليها طائف من ربك وهم نائمون

verse_text_english: By morning, it was barren.
They called on each other in the morn
“Let us harvest the crop.”
verse_text_arabic: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: ani igh'dū ʿalā ḥarthikum in kuntum ṣārimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن اغدوا على حرثكم إن كنتم صرمين

verse_text_transliterated: an lā yadkhulannahā l-yawma ʿalaykum mis'kīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن لا يدخلنها اليوم عليكم مسكين

verse_text_english: They were so absolutely sure of their harvest.
But when they saw it, they said, “We were so wrong!
“Now, we have nothing!” They Should Have Said: “God Willing. ”
The righteous among them said, “If only you had glorified (God)\”
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla awsaṭuhum alam aqul lakum lawlā tusabbiḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أوسطهم ألم أقل لكم لولا تسبحون

verse_text_english: They said, “Glory be to our Lord. We have transgressed.”
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū sub'ḥāna rabbinā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا سبحن ربنا إنا كنا ظلمين

verse_text_english: They started to blame each other.
They said, “Woe to us. We sinned.
“May our Lord grant us a better one. We repent to our Lord.”
verse_text_arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: aasa rabbuna an yubdilanakhayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona
verse_text_arabic_clean: عسى ربنا أن يبدلنا خيرا منها إنا إلى ربنا رغبون

verse_text_english: Such was the requital. But the retribution of the Hereafter is far worse, if they only knew.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

verse_text_arabic_clean: كذلك العذاب ولعذاب الءاخرة أكبر لو كانوا يعلمون

verse_text_english: The righteous have deserved, at their Lord, gardens of bliss.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna lil'muttaqīna ʿinda rabbihim jannāti l-naʿīm

verse_text_english: Shall we treat the Muslims like the criminals?
What is wrong with your logic?
Do you have another book to uphold?
In it, do you find anything you want?
Or, have you received solemn assuranc whatever you wish on the Day of Resu

verse_text_english: If it were not for his Lord’s grace, he would have been ejected into the desert as a sinner.
verse_text_arabic: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ

verse_text_arabic_clean: لولا أن تدركه نعمة من ربه لنبذ بالعراء وهو مذموم

verse_text_english: But his Lord blessed him, and made him righteous.
Those who disbelieved show their ridicule in their eyes when they hear the message and say, “He is crazy!”
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū l-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnu
